items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: So Manuel Mineta was the leader of this orchestra.

ctx.x: Where was your very first job working as a featured entertainer with a band?

Well, it's like I'm telling you, in the concerts, you see, when I was small, it was not, they never said about featured, they just had the show and all of us kids went on. But the first cabaret job, the first time I ever worked in a nightclub was right here in New Orleans out in Bucktown for Martins. And a friend of mine was playing out there in a band and he just asked me to take a ride out there and I did. And when he introduced me to the band boys, he told them how I could sing. So Manuel Mineta was the leader…
Who was in the band? Who else?
